name: More Island Events
description: Adds new island events, written by the owner, to the ones the game draws from (more come in later versions). Three here: The Aspiring Adventurer -- a villager who loves to explore sees something glinting off the safe path. "Go investigate!" finds a pile of dirt, a stack of meat (food) or a golden chest of artifacts (tech points); half the time the adventurer gets home (with the find, or with a friend's help), half the time a trap leads to death (a grave) or a disappearance (no grave). "Stay on the safe path" brings them home 9 times in 10; otherwise they are lost: hurt, healed or disabled, a skilled survivalist, killed, gone, or they join another tribe. The event is one more island event, listed and drawn like the game's own (1 in the number listed); it needs two villagers of 14 or more who are not nursing a baby and not a body or a ghost, and the adventurer and the friend who may come to help are drawn from them. The reward is a random amount from the smallest to the largest food or tech-point gain of the game's own island events (300 food for the meat, 500 to 5,000 tech points for the chest); with Island Events Scale With Population or With Stored Food and Tech Points ticked, the amount scales as that patch scales the game's own events. Deaths are the game's own ("Unknown causes", with a grave); a disappearance is logged as one in the Deaths log. The popups show the owner's text in pages that fit the screen (OK shows the next) -- with Scrolling Popups installed, one scrolling popup for the question and one for each answer's result; the effects wait for the page that tells them, and the Island Events log keeps one entry for each event. And The Playful Dolphins (The Tree of Life only): a villager of 14 or more, swimming underwater, spots a pod of dolphins. "Swim towards the dolphins": half the time the swimmer watches them hunt -- Farming becomes 100 (the game's maximum) and the village gains a large food award (twice a normal one: 600 food before the scaling); half the time a tail slaps the swimmer, who loses 30 to 50 health but never dies of it (at least 1 is left). "Hang back": a small food award (half a normal one: 150 food before the scaling). It needs two villagers of 14 or more who are not nursing a baby and not a body or a ghost; it needs no puzzle (not the Fishing Nets); it has its own share of the draw. And The Mysterious Mask (The Tree of Life only): a group of 2 to 4 children under 14 finds a strange carved mask at the edge of the forest, and the player picks one of four answers: "Wait for their parents to come" or "Cry for help" (the children are safe), "Walk towards the clearing" or "Walk towards the forest" (the same odds: home safe 50%, else lost -- then rescued 75% or captured 25%, when every child of the group is gone for good, no graves). The elders' speech tells what happened, and in every ending five volunteers of 18 or more leave on an expedition for good (no graves). It needs a population of 61 or more (the living plus the babies carried), two children under 14 and five villagers of 18 or more who are not nursing a baby and not a body or a ghost; it has its own share of the draw. With Story / Cheat Upgrades, Pick Island Event lists each of these events and picks one whenever its own requirements hold (otherwise it says what the event needs). Off by default; part of Classic VV Difficulty; Owner's Defaults ticks it. **Needs no other patch.** **Unverified in play: the event has not been seen in a running game** (emulated on the stock executable). The companion is "VVFP More Island Events.dll", started by VVFP Startup.dll; nothing is saved by it.
behavior_changes: The event is one more island event, listed and drawn like the game's own (1 in the number listed). It can happen only while at least two villagers may go: 14 or more (280 age units), alive and present, not carrying a baby, and not a body or a ghost; the adventurer and the friend of ending A8 are drawn from them, the friend never the adventurer.

Choice A, "Go investigate!": the find 50% a pile of dirt, 25% meat (a food award: 300 food), 25% a golden chest (a tech award: 500 to 5,000 tech points); then 50% a surviving ending (after the dirt A7 or A9; after a find A1, A5 or A8, which give the reward) and 50% a deadly one (A2 and A4 die, the game's own death with cause -1 and a grave; A3 and A6 disappear, no body), each equally likely within its half.

Choice B, "Stay on the safe path": 90% home safe; 10% lost, then 1 in 6 each: the healers (1 in 3 each: dies; a full recovery; health set to 10-50 and running disliked), joins another tribe (gone for good, no grave), a survivalist (+20 to 30 in Farming, Building, Research or Healing, at most 100), dies under a fallen tree, dies at the bottom of a cliff, disappears.

The reward is drawn, each amount equally likely, from the game's smallest to its largest stock island-event gain of that kind (src/vv_aspiring_adventurer.py AWARD_RANGES), and goes through the game's own food or tech writer; with Island Events Scale With Population or With Stored Food and Tech Points ticked, the amount scales as that patch scales the game's own events. The effects wait for their own page (the page that ends the ending's text), and the event writes its own one Island Events log entry; a disappearance is told to the Cause of Death companion (VvfpCauseVanishedBy), so its Deaths log records it as one.

The owner's words, by translation key (the event's popup shows the player's language when a translation has them), are laid out in pages that fit the game's popup -- whole paragraphs, else whole sentences -- each shown in turn with OK.

The Playful Dolphins (The Tree of Life): the swimmer is a villager who may be picked (vv4_eligible: present +0x1CC4, alive +0x1C40, 14 or more +0x1B8C, adv_is_protected: nursing +0x1C4C, a body or ghost +0x1CC7), drawn among them; it can happen while two such villagers live, with no puzzle (not the Fishing Nets). One more two-choice object with the Adventurer's virtual table and methods (adv_flow), its own entry in the draw (t_list). "Swim towards the dolphins": rand(100) < 50 the hunt -- Farming (float +0x1C5C) +200 capped at 100.0, as the game's own skill adder 0x46AD80 caps (the double 100.0 at 0x48A7C0) -- and a large food award (the game's range x 2, then Island Events Scale, through 0x41D920), else the tail slap: health (+0x1C40, 0..100, in the block +0x1C34) minus 30 to 50, never below 1, through the game's own setter 0x46AF00 (value, cause -1: never its death path). "Hang back": a small food award (the range x 1 / 2, then Island Events Scale). The effects are made when the ending's last page is shown, with the event's one Island Events log entry. No site of its own.

The Mysterious Mask (The Tree of Life): the group is 4 children under 14 (+0x1B8C < 280), or all of them when fewer (at least 2), the expedition 5 villagers of 18 or more (vv4_eligible and +0x1B8C >= 360), each drawn among those left; everyone passes adv_is_protected (nursing +0x1C4C, a body or ghost +0x1CC7); the population 61 or more counted as the game's own 0x467610 counts (present +0x1CC4, not a body +0x1CC7, health +0x1C40 > 0, plus the babies +0x1C50 while carrying +0x1C4C). One more object with the Adventurer's virtual table and methods (adv_flow, answers 4: the shared multi-answer popup native/shared/vvfp_multi_answer.h, ids 4 and 5 and the keys 1 to 4), its own entry in the draw (t_list). A walk: rand(100) < 50 home safe, else lost: rand(100) < 25 captured, else rescued. Its pages are laid out 6 lines shorter (3 for each answer past two) so the popup is no taller than a two-answer one. The five volunteers, and when captured every child of the group, are removed as a living villager is (adv_vv345.inc t_vanish: no body, no grave; told to Cause of Death) when the elders' last page is shown, with the event's one Island Events log entry. No site of its own.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion writes each site at run time, only after verifying every site's stock bytes (all of them, or none); without it the event does not exist.
Every stock event, its odds, the island-event timer and counting, the rescue rules and Custom Island Events are unchanged; nothing is saved by the companion.
evidence_status: implemented from exact-build disassembly; the draw, the popup pages, both choices' effects and the install with every other patch emulated on the stock executable in tests/test_aspiring_adventurer.py (The Playful Dolphins: who, both branches at their odds, Farming 100, the awards, the health loss that never kills, the effects on the last page, the log entry, the words and the draw, in tests/test_playful_dolphins.py; The Mysterious Mask: who, the 61 / 60 population, 1 / 2 children, 4 / 5 adults, all four answers by mouse and key, each elders' speech, both disappearances, the effects on the last page, the log entry, the words and the four buttons, in tests/test_mysterious_mask.py); runtime/player confirmation pending
